release_notes: All Receipts lists sales, deliveries, consumption, debts, expenses, stock requests, and approvals. A signed-in Super Admin can approve stock changes and restore a voided sale or consumption without entering the PIN again. A manager still enters the PIN, and a cashier sends a void request instead of voiding the sale. Product photographs can be added from the till and the dashboard and are included in the shop backup. A sale keeps its product names and line totals.
